headline: Trump 🍊👑 PAUSES Korea Drills 🤝🇰🇷 After Seoul SNUBS Iran Beef 🛑🇮🇷
text: Donald "Big Orange" 🍊👨‍💼 Trump just FLEXED 💪📢 on Truth Social 📱 saying US 🇺🇸 gonna SLASH ✂️ the big joint war games 🎮⚔️ with South Korea 🇰🇷 cuz he and Kim Jong Un 🤝🇰🇵 got that "VERY GOOD RELATIONSHIP" 💕👬! Trump said these drills cost a FORTUNE 💰💸 and make Kimmy mad 😡 so he's putting them on ICE 🧊❄️! Seoul said "NO THANKS" 😤 when he asked them to help denuke Iran 🇮🇷💥 and now Trump's feelings are HURT 🥺💔! The military exercises start MONDAY 🗓️ but Trump says it's TOO LATE to cancel ❌ so they'll go ahead but get CUT DOWN 📉🔪! Meanwhile Kim is launching MISSILES 🚀💥 like fireworks 🎆 and South Korea 🇰🇷 is still gonna train with 18,000 soldiers 🪖👥 plus 28,500 American GIs 🇺🇸 stationed there! Trump posted a THROWBACK 📸 of him and Kim from 2018 saying they're "GREAT FRIENDS" 💕 despite the grumpy faces 😠! Last time Trump paused these drills was 2018 when he was trying to make peace 🕊️ with North Korea! South Korea's president wants to END the Korean War officially 🏁✍️ even though it's been on PAUSE since 1953! Pyongyang hasn't said JACK SQUAT 🤐 but they're still salty 😒 about the war games! Trump also roasted Japan 🇯🇵, France 🇫🇷 and UK 🇬🇧 for not helping with Iran beef! The whole thing is giving MAJOR "America First" vibes 🇺🇸💪 while North Korea keeps flexing its nukes ☢️💪!
